verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a full API reference: a canonical OpenAPI schema with 174 paths, a generated plain-text endpoint reference, and an unauthenticated Developer MCP server that serves the API reference and schemas to AI assistants. Its guides include working example requests (e.g., a working POST /bills request) that can run against the documented sandbox API base. However, nothing shows an interactive reference UI with in-browser runnable examples; the evidence only notes the rendered pages are JavaScript shells. missing for 10: documented interactive try-it console in the API reference, runnable examples embedded per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
